_note: Thai names of things: crops, animals and their goods, fish and where they live, food and dishes, forage, mine finds, keepsakes, kitchen tools, shops, maps, festivals, people and the village record. Japanese dishes keep the names Thai players know them by (โมจิ, ดังโงะ); the rest is said plainly.
